name: Los Angeles
climate_june_july: Warm and dry, 22–28°C, almost no rain. Evenings can be cool near the coast.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: LA has two venues — SoFi in Inglewood and Rose Bowl in Pasadena. Check which one your match is at. Use Metro C Line for SoFi and Metro Gold Line for Rose Bowl. Rent a car only if you know LA — traffic is brutal on match days.

name: New York / New Jersey
climate_june_july: Warm and humid, 24–32°C. Occasional thunderstorms in the afternoon.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Stay in Manhattan — the energy, hotels, and food are far superior to staying near the stadium. Take NJ Transit from Penn Station on match day trains (1 hour). Book NJ Transit tickets in advance as they sell out.

name: Dallas / Arlington
climate_june_july: Very hot and sunny, 35–42°C. Low humidity. Intense afternoon sun — plan accordingly.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: The stadium is fully air-conditioned — relief from the heat inside. Get an Uber/Lyft; public transport options are limited. Deep Ellum in Dallas has the best nightlife and food scene.

name: Vancouver
climate_june_july: Mild and pleasant, 18–24°C. Occasional light rain. Best weather of all host cities.
visa_info: eTA required for visa-exempt nationals flying in. Apply at canada.ca/eta. US citizens do not need an eTA.
fan_advice: Best public transport of any World Cup venue — Canada Line goes directly from the airport to Stadium-Chinatown in 25 minutes. Stay in Downtown or Yaletown. Book early as Vancouver has limited hotel stock.

name: Mexico City
climate_june_july: Mild at altitude — 16–24°C. Rainy season begins; expect afternoon showers. Altitude at 2,240m.
visa_info: Most nationalities enter visa-free for up to 180 days. Check your specific country at gob.mx/sre.
fan_advice: Most affordable host city by far. Stay in Polanco, Condesa, or Roma Norte — safe, walkable, and full of restaurants. Give yourself 1–2 days to acclimatise to the altitude before match day. Uber is the safest way to get around.

name: Guadalajara
climate_june_july: Warm with afternoon rains, 18–28°C. Mexico's second city has a pleasant microclimate.
visa_info: Most nationalities enter visa-free for up to 180 days. Check your specific country at gob.mx/sre.
fan_advice: Zapopan municipality (where the stadium is) is safe and modern. The centro histórico is 20 minutes away and worth exploring. Tequila town is just 60km away — worth a day trip around a match.

name: Seattle
climate_june_july: Mild and occasionally overcast, 16–22°C. Driest months of the year — less rain than reputation suggests.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Link Light Rail goes directly from Sea-Tac airport to Stadium station in 40 minutes — easiest airport-to-venue connection in the USA. Pioneer Square neighbourhood is the best pre-match area.

name: Chicago
climate_june_july: Warm and pleasant, 22–30°C. Lake Michigan breezes keep it cooler than inland cities. Occasional thunderstorms.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Stay in the Loop or River North and walk to the lakefront on match day. The Museum Campus setting along Lake Michigan is one of the most scenic World Cup venues. Take CTA Red Line to Roosevelt and then enjoy the lakefront walk to the stadium.

name: Miami
climate_june_july: Hot and very humid, 30–36°C with high humidity. Afternoon thunderstorms common. Feels like 40°C+ in direct sun.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Stay on South Beach or in Brickell for the best experience — the stadium is in Miami Gardens, 30 mins north. Plan travel early; I-95 and I-195 get gridlocked on match days. South American fans will feel very at home — Miami has a huge Latin community.

name: Kansas City
climate_june_july: Hot and humid, 28–36°C. Thunderstorms possible. Most underrated host city.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Most affordable US host city — great value on hotels and food. The Power & Light District is a brilliant fan zone. Kansas City BBQ is world-famous; Joe's KC and Q39 are essential stops. Use match-day shuttles from Union Station.

name: Boston / Foxborough
climate_june_july: Warm and pleasant, 22–28°C. Low humidity compared to other eastern US cities. Occasional afternoon showers.
visa_info: ESTA for most nationalities. Apply at esta.cbp.dhs.gov at least 72 hours before travel.
fan_advice: Stay in Boston — Back Bay and Downtown are excellent bases with great food and nightlife. Take the Commuter Rail from South Station to Foxboro on match day (50 mins). Book rail tickets early; they sell out fast for high-profile matches.
